description.value: 49th Parallel Café & Lucky's Doughnuts is a well-established Vancouver institution pairing specialty 49th Parallel coffee with handcrafted Lucky's Doughnuts made fresh on-site from scratch throughout the day. The downtown Thurlow location, at the corner of West Georgia and Thurlow, is the chain's third outpost and uniquely features a kitchen serving breakfast sandwiches and brunch plates alongside the famous seasonal doughnuts. Indoor and outdoor seating and wheelchair accessibility round out what is a capable urban rest stop in the heart of downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 8m; stands (8 spaces) at 45m; stands (5 spaces) at 57m; stands (4 spaces) at 78m; stands (5 spaces) at 95m. Total: 27 spaces.

concerns: Phone number (604-620-4905) sourced from website contact page for the Thurlow/Downtown location; OSM record has no phone populated.

Website homepage banner prominently displays '2902 Main St, Vancouver' (the Main St flagship location); the contact page correctly lists the Thurlow location at 689 Thurlow St matching OSM — no real discrepancy, but the multi-location website may cause address confusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café with indoor and outdoor seating in downtown Vancouver; a natural food and coffee stop for touring cyclists, pending field verification of bike parking.
